HOW TO PLAY

Phone: joystick moves (push up to jump). ATK for a 3-hit combo, BLOCK to guard, DASH to dodge. Power buttons use energy and glow when ready. ULT needs full energy. SWAP changes fighter.

Keyboard: A/D move, W jump, J attack, K block, L dash, U / I powers, O ultimate, M music, P pause.

Domain Expansion (button DOMAIN / key E): with full energy, expand your domain. The arena becomes your domain and every hit lands for several seconds while you hit harder. Hold BLOCK for Simple Domain (takes much less damage), or tap DOMAIN with full energy to start a Domain Clash.

Win by knocking out the single opponent before time runs out. Hitting and being hit fills cursed energy.

Coins: every win gives coins (100 on level 1, +50 more for each higher level). Spend them on the sorcerer screen to unlock new fighters. Only YUJI is free at the start.

Music: the battle song plays during matches. Use the ♫ button at the top of the battle screen or the M key to turn it on/off. Music and effects volume can be changed in SETTINGS. Top buttons in battle: II = pause, ♫ = music, 🏠 = back to main menu.

Codes: tap ENTER CODE on the main menu to redeem a code.
